description: This file defines a validation rule class 'TimesheetCommentDateParamRule' used within the OrangeHRM Time module. It checks if a provided date falls within the start and end dates of a specific timesheet, identified by its ID.

classes.name: TimesheetCommentDateParamRule
classes.description: A validation rule class that ensures a given date parameter falls within the relevant timesheet's date range.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the rule with a specific timesheet ID.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates whether the input date string falls within the start and end dates of the corresponding timesheet.
